# Geofields Tanzania Limited

> Integrated diamond core, reverse circulation and auger drilling, geological exploration, underground support, mining supplies and mining services for Tanzania and Africa.

Geofields Tanzania Limited is a Dar es Salaam–based mining services company. Head office: Mwai Kibaki Road, Mbezi Beach, P.O Box 76387, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Phone: +255 766 775 255 and +255 755 284 141. Email: info@geofields.co.tz and sales@geofields.co.tz. WhatsApp: https://wa.me/255766775255 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/geofieldstanzanialtd/

## Pages

- [Home](https://geofields.co.tz/): Company overview, services, fleet highlights and contact
- [About](https://geofields.co.tz/about): Vision, mission, values and history
- [Services](https://geofields.co.tz/divisions): Drilling, geological exploration and mining services
- [Underground Support (GUS)](https://geofields.co.tz/gus): Ground support, rock bolting and mine development
- [Drilling Fleet](https://geofields.co.tz/fleet): Diamond core, RC and auger rigs, including 1,600 m capability
- [Projects](https://geofields.co.tz/projects): Gold, nickel, lithium and limestone programmes across Tanzania
- [Safety & HSE](https://geofields.co.tz/safety): ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 aligned zero-harm practice
- [Community](https://geofields.co.tz/community): Local engagement and social investment
- [Request a Quote](https://geofields.co.tz/request-quote): Sales enquiries and project quotations
